title: KCP space_access_grant_list result (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for space_access_grant_list (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). §11.5 page of SpaceAccessGrant projections (gap notes KG4/KG9). §11.5 page shape verbatim: { items[], next?, snapshot, boundary_event_cursor }. The first page creates a stable snapshot token (expiry >= 15 minutes); further pages see the same logical boundary or return snapshot-expired; authorization is rechecked for every page (gap note KG9).

items.description: Page of SpaceAccessGrant projections; at most 512 items (§11.8 page read limit).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

items.description: Granted action token; no action vocabulary is pinned (gap note KG19). A grant is intersected with current membership, policy, classification, and source authorization on every use (§10.2).

spaceAccessGrant.description: SpaceAccessGrant projection, field names verbatim from the §10.2 record shape (gap notes KG4/KG19); it cannot outlive or widen its source authority (§10.2).

statusToken.description: Bounded lowercase token for a field DESIGN.md names without pinning a value space; pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
